name: io.github.beepboop2025/liquilens
title: LiquiLens: the record of India's banks and lenders
description: Free bank-filing and counterparty research; cited evidence limits; the public MCP is open to all.

tools.name: bank_asset_quality_review
tools.description: Cited bank/SFB/UCB NPA, PCR and capital evidence. Keep provisional updates and periods separate. No score, credit or execution authority.

tools.name: bank_credit_land_stress
tools.description: Loan quality, NPA bridge, state NPA and housing loans vs peer block, geo context. Exact IDs; district is not measured lending exposure. full:true for cells. No score.

tools.name: bank_npa_reconciliation
tools.description: Reconcile NPA movements; keep recoveries, write-offs, sales and upgrades distinct. Inputs are not authenticated.

tools.name: banking_specialisation_coverage
tools.description: Bank/SFB/UCB coverage, stale/missing evidence and separate census counts. No rating.

tools.name: corporate_transmission_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: US firm funding stress? Household credit has its own board. CP/credit lines/real economy; gaps in cannot_see. Seiche excluded from signals. Display-only, no score/tier. full:true adds methods.

tools.name: crypto_exposure_board
tools.description: Cited bank/crypto amounts, stablecoin/venue links and Undertow run-risk context. REST has detail. No institution score or investment advice.

tools.name: crypto_regime_board
tools.description: BTC/ETH change points, log-SR, shifts and counts; disclosed bank exposure context. REST has paths. No institution score or investment advice.

tools.name: economy_bond_markets
tools.description: Bond statistics and cross-product economic readings by ISO market, each with its own source dates and state; stale or restricted stays a gap. Omit market for a summary; page with offset.

tools.name: evidence_europe
tools.description: Seven cited European retrospective case files through unrecalibrated Indian lenses. Named case studies, not a cohort: no European recall percentage to quote.

slug.description: case-file slug, e.g. 'credit-suisse'; omit for all seven

tools.name: evidence_india
tools.description: 48-institution Indian construction-PIT crisis diagnostic, including misses and false alarms. Publication clocks where present, else a +60-day filing-lag proxy; overwritten amendments are unreconstructable. Full replays are served per case.

tools.name: evidence_institution
tools.description: A sourced Indian construction-PIT quarterly replay, lens alert timing and hit/miss/false-alarm verdict. Slugs from the India diagnostic. Filing-availability proxies do not establish a validated backtest.

tools.name: evidence_markets
tools.description: Historical evidence: India (48-institution construction-PIT diagnostic), US (industry-wide current-amended vintage), Europe (named cases, no cohort claim). Start here; the India, US and Europe tools hold the detail.

tools.name: evidence_us
tools.description: US bank current-amended-vintage diagnostics and named replays, including misses. Not a validated point-in-time backtest. Report the quarterly top-decile budgeted watchlist beside recall, uncertainty and lead times; not an individual-bank verdict.

include_trajectories.description: per-quarter score series for marquee replays (large)

tools.name: failure_radar_board
tools.description: Vetted Indian lender PDs, PCA/SAF and funding. market_dd requires tier authority; diagnostic clocks/refusals stay in market_dd_evidence. Slugs key the institution dossiers. Research, not a rating.

tools.name: failure_radar_institution
tools.description: One Indian lender dossier: quarterly PDs and drivers, PCA/SAF headroom, funding, forensic and listed-market evidence. Slugs from the Failure Radar board. Uncovered institutions remain absent, never scored from memory.

tools.name: forward_odds
tools.description: Counted Markov transitions and empirical 5/20-day reach odds, withheld until 60 observed days; counts stay visible and absence is never precision. Historical frequencies are not calibrated forecasts. Display-only, never a state driver.

tools.name: household_credit_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: US household credit stress? Firm funding has its own board. Delinquency, charge-offs, revolving credit; unscored debt service. Gaps in cannot_see. No score/tier. full:true adds history.

full.description: adds method_note, thresholds, labels, full sparklines

tools.name: institution_evidence_monitor
tools.description: Bank/NBFC evidence, gaps and review alerts. slug: one record; slugs: watchlist; neither: all tracked. End-of-day as_of. No scoring or delivery authority.

tools.name: institution_research_coverage
tools.description: Search Indian dossiers, RBI rows or NAFSCOB co-op census. Overlapping populations; listing grants no coverage or score.

tools.name: institution_review_packet
tools.description: Cited human review packet for an exact slug or unique normalized full name. No fuzzy match or new score; stale/dark gaps retained. Content hash detects alteration, not attestation or publication-time proof.

tools.name: latest_article
tools.description: Today's exact full-text LiquiLens editorial: current institution-risk analysis when the evidence moved, else a labelled historical replay. Quote it with its evidence clock and passing publication receipt, without regenerating facts.

tools.name: lending_geography
tools.description: Co-op operating areas and dated district environment. IDs: in-dccb-, in-stcb-, in-dist-, in-state-. No score.

tools.name: ontology_context
tools.description: Start here for a named bank, NBFC, series, market or place. Resolves a name or key (CIN, LEI, ISIN, CUSIP, series code) to one canonical id: identity, links, events and which LiquiLens, Seiche, Undertow and Palimpsest reads serve it, with exact arguments. Routing, not evidence.

tools.name: rbi_supervisory_tape
tools.description: RBI penalties, licence cancellations and directions, newest first with source URLs; missing snapshots stay explicit.

tools.name: research_network
tools.description: Palimpsest sources, Seiche funding, Undertow liquidity and NarcoScope metadata. Rights retained; no identity, score or eligibility changes.

tools.name: stablecoin_rails_board
tools.description: Paged peg/run evidence; partial data is never CALM. Follow pagination.next_offset. Full receipts on REST. Display-only, not investment advice.

tools.name: universe_search
tools.description: Search the RBI NBFC register. Supply q or a filter; a filter without q browses that slice. Registration does not establish creditworthiness.

tools.name: verify_published_record
tools.description: Check ledger hash chains, enabled signatures and anchors; retain failures. Record integrity, not economic accuracy.
